force.source: fix tool global vector: force ON the indenter, already a reaction load
force.normal: mean(f_tool[3]) over forceMeanWindow; signed +z upward reaction
force.tangential: mean(-f_tool[1]) over forceMeanWindow; signed resistance to +x motion, not sqrt(Fx^2+Fy^2)
force.scope: Idealized rigid repulsive sphere reaction loads; not hardness, contact stress, or experimentally validated grinding force

temperature.selection: all mobile atoms, including bath and dynamic groups
temperature.scope: Driven short trajectory; equilibration or steady state is not demonstrated. Actual thermostat groups/damping are listed in commandDefinitions.

energy.scope: Default fix indent energy is excluded unless fix_modify tool energy yes is present; no total-energy conservation claim

interpretationLimits: Nominal depth is measured against the initial surface; contact-atom penetration and pile-up are not inferred from force magnitude alone.
